<sense>

<italic>ring</italic> used as weight and as uncoined money (v. 
<xref rid="Q00707">פִּילֵס</xref>).</definition>

<sup>b</sup> (expl. אסימון, ib. IV, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<xref rid="A00083">פִּילְסָא)</xref></language-reference> uncoined metal.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 65
<sup>a</sup> ליעבד לה פ' let him use any circular plate for it (instead of a coin, סלע).—
<plural-form>Pl. פּוּלְסִין, פּוּלְסֵי</plural-form>. Lev. R. s. 37 יהבת ליה אנתתיה עשרה פ' וכ' (not יהבי) his wife gave him ten

<sup>b</sup> מחיוה שתין פ' דנ' they (in heaven) punished him with sixty fiery lashes; Yoma 77
<sup>a</sup> (omitted in eds.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3; Ms. M. פּוּלְסִים h. form); Ḥag. 15
<sup>a</sup>. B. Mets. 47
<sup>a</sup> הוה מפיק פ' דנ' (Rashi פולסא) he would have brought out before thee (shown thee) fiery disks (i.e. would have threatened thee with excommunication).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q00246">
<head-word>פּוּם</head-word>
<head-word>פּוּמָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> = h. פֶּה.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ex. IV, 11. Targ. Y. ib. 10, v. חִגְּרָא. Targ. O. Gen. XXIX, 2, sq.; (Y. פֻּם); a. fr.—Targ. II Sam. XXIII, 8 בפ' קלא with the voice of command (?).—Sabb. 67
<sup>b</sup> לפ' רבנן to the mouth of our teachers, v. חַיִּין. Ib. 141
<sup>a</sup> אפּוּמֵיה דלחייא on the top of the pole. Ib. בפ' דשישא into the orifice of a bottle, v. אֲשִׁישָׁא. Ber. 62
<sup>a</sup> דמי פומיה דאבא וכ' Abba’s mouth is like that of one that has never before sipped of a dish (he acts as if he touched a woman for the first time). Y. Ned. VII, end, 40
<sup>c</sup> לית אורחא … בפ' בעי מימר וכ' is it not a man’s way (of speaking), when he sees a person at the entrance (of the town), to say, I saw him in Tiberias?; a. v. fr.—כְּפוּם, לְפוּם, לְפוּמָא ד־ = h. כְּפִי, לְפִי, 
<italic>according to; because</italic>. Targ. Lev. XXV, 52. Ib. 51. Targ. Prov. XII, 8 לפ' ed. Lag. (ed. בפ', (corr. acc.). Targ. Y. I Gen. XXXVIII, 25; a. fr.—לפ' כן = h. לְפִיכָךְ, 
<italic>therefore</italic>. Ib.; a. fr.—Ab. V, 22 לפ' צערא אגרא according to the pain (in studying) is the reward. Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>c</sup> bot. לפ' כן צריך וכ' therefore was it necessary to say &c.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פּוּמִין, פּוּמַיָּא</plural-form>. Targ. Prov. V, 4; a. e.—Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>b</sup> top אילו הוינא … תרין פ' had I been standing at the foot of Mount Sinai, I should have prayed that two mouths should be created for man, one for studying the Law &c.; Y. Sabb. I, 3
<sup>a</sup> sq.; a. e.—[Hebr. plur. פּוּמִין, v. פֶּה.]—פום בדיתא, v. פּוּמְבְּדִיתָא.—פום נהרא, v. נַהֲרָא, &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q00254">
<head-word>פּוֹמְפִּי</head-word>
<head-word>פּוֹמְבִּי</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (πομπή, pompa) 
<italic>solemn procession, pomp, solemnity, ostentation</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shek. I, beg. 45
<sup>d</sup> כדי לעשות פומבי לדבר (Ms. M. פוספי, read פומפי) in order to give greater publicity to the act; Y. Yoma II, 39
<sup>d</sup> top; ib. II, end, 40
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Pesik. R. s. 12 לפי שלא נעשית לה פ' כאמהות because she had not been given a public funeral as was given to the other Mothers. Ib. היה נעשה להם פ' (masc.). Ib. s. 5 עשה להם פומבה גדולה made a great demonstration for them. B. Bath. 145
<sup>b</sup> עשה עמו בפ' וכ' if a man acted as a friend’s best man at a public wedding, and now asks his friend to be his best man at a private wedding. Ib. עתיר נכסין עתיר פ' וכ' rich in goods, rich in pomp (popular ovations)—that is the preacher of 
<italic>hagadah</italic> (v. אֲגָדָה); a. fr.—Trnsf. (v. Sophocles s. v. πομπή) 
<italic>disgrace, reproach</italic>. Ab. Zar. 54
<sup>b</sup> לא דיין … שעושין סלע שלי פ' וכ' it is not enough for the wicked that they have made my coin (divine image of man) a public disgrace, but &c.—Gen. R. s. 86, beg. בני בכורי הוא ואני מורידו פורופי Ar. (read: פומפי = πομπῇ) he (Jacob) is my firstborn son, and shall I let him go down to Egypt in disgrace?—Ed. בני … בבזיון ואם ליתן בלבו של פרעה איני מורידו פומבי אלא וכ' (corr. after ‘Rashi’ ואם אתן בלבו … להורידו איני מורידו פ') he is my firstborn son, and shall I make him go down in contempt? and if I put it into Pharaoh’s heart to bring him down, do I not bring him down in disgrace? (‘Rashi’ אני מורידו פופילא, corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> (not פונדיין); a. fr.—Bekh. 50
<sup>a</sup> פּוּנְדִּין.—
<plural-form>Pl. פּוּנְדְּיוֹנִין, פּוּנְדְּיוֹנוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Kidd. I, 58

<pos> m.</pos>

<sense>

<italic>inn, tavern, lodging place</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 26
<sup>a</sup> שעשאו פ' לשלשה בני אדם (not ישראל; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) when he made his house a lodging place for three persons (at the same time). Sot. 10
<sup>a</sup> (expl. אשל, Gen. XXI, 33) חד אמר פרדס וחד אמר פ' one says, it means, Abraham planted an orchard, and one says, he put up an inn (for the reception of travellers); Gen. R. s. 54 (with play on א̇ש̇ל̇) פונדיק ש̇א̇ל̇ מה תשאל וכ' an inn, (where they say,) ask what you may desire, cake, meat, &c. Macc. 10
<sup>b</sup> הקב"ה מזמינן לפונדיק אחד the Lord causes them to meet at the same inn. Yeb. XVI, 7 (122
<sup>a</sup>) והביאוהו בפונדוק (Y. ed. בפונדק) and they brought him (the sick man) to an inn; a. fr.—[Y. B. Mets. V, 10
<sup>c</sup> bot. אבל בפ', read: בפִיסּוּק.]—
<plural-form>Pl. פּוּנְדְּקות</plural-form>. Men. 32
<sup>b</sup> בפוּנְדְּקוֹתֵיהֶן at the door of their lodgings.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<notes> Part. pass. פָּזוּר; f. פְּזוּרָה; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּזוּרִים, פְּזוּרִין; פְּזוּרוֹת</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 7, end וכשהן פ' שכינה עמהם and when they (the Israelites) are scattered, the Divine Presence is with them; a. e.—Ex. R. s. 15 היו פוזרין, read: חוזרין, v. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> יְפַזֵּר מעותיו לעניים let him scatter his money (give liberally) among the poor. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to צדקת פרזונו, Jud. V, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> צדקה … שפִּזְּרָן וכ' (or שפְּזָרָן 
<italic>Kal</italic>) the Lord has done kindness to Israel in scattering it among the nations.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 10
<sup>a</sup> רוח מְפַזַּרְתָּן the wind disperses them (the clouds). Midr. Sam. ch. XXV אם מְפַזֵּר הוא דברים whether he would scatter abroad (divulge) the affairs, v. קוּסְדַּרְיוֹת; a. e.—Part. pass. מְפוּזָּר; f. מְפוּזֶּרֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְפוּזָּרִים, מְפוּזָּרִין; מְפוּזָּרוֹת</plural-form>. Neg. IV, 3 במפ' when the hairs on the leprous spot are wide apart, opp. מכונס, v. כָּנַס. Meg. 13
<sup>b</sup> מפ' הן בין העמים they are scattered among the nations (of the kingdom), v. פָּרַד. T’bul Yom II, 3 אם היה מפ' וכ' if the garlic was scattered in the mortar; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִתְפַּזֵּר 
<italic>to be scattered, dispersed</italic>.</definition>
